subject: Money
title: Interest Rate Policy
description: A short lesson to help you apply Interest Rate Policy.

hook.text: In March 2022, the Fed rate was 0.25%. By July 2023, it was 5.5%. The fastest hike cycle in 40 years.

buildup.text: Central banks raise rates to slow inflation and lower them to stimulate growth. It's their primary tool.

discovery.text: Higher rates make borrowing expensive. Mortgages, car loans, and business credit all cost more. Spending slows.

twist.text: Rate changes take 12-18 months to fully hit the economy. Central banks drive while looking in the rearview mirror.

climax.text: Too fast risks recession. Too slow lets inflation entrench. Central banking is a permanent balancing act.

punchline.text: One number moves the entire economy.

quiz.question: Why do rate changes take 12-18 months to fully affect the economy?
options: Economic decisions take time to adjust
